llm.summary: This is a plain ecommerce audit template that asks users to manually provide store metrics and does not include code, hidden access, or install-time behavior.

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose matches its content: it guides monthly TikTok Shop or ecommerce store health reviews across sales, content, returns, fulfillment, and growth opportunities.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are limited to collecting user-provided metrics and producing a structured advisory report; it explicitly says it does not connect to live dashboards or pull real-time data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only a single SKILL.md file with no executable scripts, dependency installation, network calls, or install-time mutations.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The requested inputs can include business performance data and optional customer feedback, which is proportionate to the audit purpose but may be sensitive if pasted with raw customer identifiers.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background execution, privilege escalation, credential use, session/profile access, or local file indexing is requested.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is reasonable to install for manual ecommerce reporting. Before using it, avoid pasting unnecessary sensitive details such as customer names, emails, order IDs, support-ticket transcripts, or private financial records beyond the metrics needed for the audit.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector clean result] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues, which is consistent with the instruction-only artifact.
[Static scan clean result] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns and artifact review found no code or hidden behavior.
[VirusTotal pending telemetry] expected: VirusTotal was pending and provides no negative artifact-backed signal.
